items_all.title: Daily AI usage in the U.S. has more than doubled in just six months
items_all.summary: Surveys by Epoch AI and Ipsos suggest AI is becoming part of everyday life for more Americans. The share of US adults using AI almost daily more than doubled between March and August 2026, rising from 8 percent to 19 percent. Meanwhile, the share using it just once a week fell from 17 percent to 10 percent. The article Daily AI usage in the U.S. has more than doubled in just six months appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Epoch AI 與 Ipsos 的調查顯示，人工智慧正逐漸成為更多美國人日常生活的一部分。在 2026 年 3 月至 8 月期間，幾乎每天都在使用的美國成年人比例成長了一倍以上，從 8% 上升至 19%。同時，僅每週使用一次的比例則從 17% 下降至 10%。文章〈Daily AI usage in the U.S. has more than doubled in just six months〉最初發布於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Simulated students that make realistic mistakes help AI tutors learn faster
items_all.summary: Microsoft and the University of Illinois built StudentSim to replicate individual students from limited data and give AI tutors fast, low-cost feedback. In tests covering 60 students across chess, English, and math, it outperformed GPT-5.4. A chess tutor trained with StudentSim also earned the highest expert ratings among three versions tested. The article Simulated students that make realistic mistakes help AI tutors learn faster appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 微軟 與伊利諾大學合作建立了 StudentSim，透過有限的資料來模擬個別學生，為 AI 家教提供快速、低成本的回饋。在涵蓋棋藝、英文和數學等 60 名學生的測試中，它的表現優於 GPT-5.4。由 StudentSim 訓練出來的棋藝家教也在受測的三個版本中獲得最高的專家評分。文章〈Simulated students that make realistic mistakes help AI tutors learn faster〉最初發布於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Following OpenAI, Anthropic is also reportedly postponing its IPO
items_all.summary: Anthropic is reportedly delaying its IPO from October to November 2026 to present strong Q3 results. Investors expect a roughly $2 trillion valuation, but rising infrastructure costs, including $1.25 billion a month for its SpaceX deal alone, and unresolved security risks complicate the listing. The article Following OpenAI, Anthropic is also reportedly postponing its IPO appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 據傳 Anthropic 正在將其首次公開募股（IPO）從 2026 年 10 月延後至 11 月，以便呈現強勁的第三季業績。投資人預期估值約為 2 兆美元，但不斷上升的基礎設施成本（僅與 SpaceX 合作案每月就高達 12.5 億美元）以及未解決的安全風險使上市變得複雜。這篇報導「繼 OpenAI 之後，據傳 Anthropic 也將延後首次公開募股（IPO）」首先發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable turn robot arms into slapstick killer robots in new safety benchmark
items_all.summary: Leading AI models usually attempt dangerous tasks rather than refuse them when controlling a robot, according to the RoboHarm benchmark. GPT-6 Astra stabbed a baby doll in 17 of 20 trials, while Claude Fable 5.1 put a can of compressed air on a burning stove. None of the three models tested reliably rejected unsafe commands. The article GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable turn robot arms into slapstick killer robots in new safety benchmark appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 根摤 RoboHarm 基準渥攢性準，領先的 AI 模型在控制樅器人時，通常會層試驗做昂險險的任務，而非拒絕他們。GPT-6 Astra 在 20 次試驗中有 17 次刺刺了嬰兒嬃偶，而 Claude Fable 5.1 則將一罐壓縮空氣放在煨火的爐子上。渥渥渥臦試驗的三個模型沒有一個能靠降地拒絕不安全的命令。文章 GPT-6 Astra 和 Claude Fable 在新的安全基準中將樅器人臂變成了鐧笑殺手樅器人，首先發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.summary: Release: datasette-auth-github 1.0 I run this GitHub login plugin on the agent.datasette.io demo site and I noticed that my authenticated sessions weren't lasting very long. It turned out that the plugin was setting cookies without a Max-Age parameter, so they were expiring at the end of a browser session (which in Mobile Safari seems to happen pretty often, independently of how you are using the app.) I fixed that in #80 and, since this plugin has been around for quite a while and is tested against both Datasette 0.65.x and Datasette 1.0ax, I decided to bump it up to a 1.0 release. I'm trying to get better at promoting stable plugins to 1.0. Tags: github , plugins , datasette

items_all_raw.title: Simulated students that make realistic mistakes help AI tutors learn faster
items_all_raw.summary: Microsoft and the University of Illinois built StudentSim to replicate individual students from limited data and give AI tutors fast, low-cost feedback. In tests covering 60 students across chess, English, and math, it outperformed GPT-5.4. A chess tutor trained with StudentSim also earned the highest expert ratings among three versions tested. The article Simulated students that make realistic mistakes help AI tutors learn faster appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 微軟 與伊利諾大學合作建立了 StudentSim，透過有限的資料來模擬個別學生，為 AI 家教提供快速、低成本的回饋。在涵蓋棋藝、英文和數學等 60 名學生的測試中，它的表現優於 GPT-5.4。由 StudentSim 訓練出來的棋藝家教也在受測的三個版本中獲得最高的專家評分。文章〈Simulated students that make realistic mistakes help AI tutors learn faster〉最初發布於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Following OpenAI, Anthropic is also reportedly postponing its IPO
items_all_raw.summary: Anthropic is reportedly delaying its IPO from October to November 2026 to present strong Q3 results. Investors expect a roughly $2 trillion valuation, but rising infrastructure costs, including $1.25 billion a month for its SpaceX deal alone, and unresolved security risks complicate the listing. The article Following OpenAI, Anthropic is also reportedly postponing its IPO appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 據傳 Anthropic 正在將其首次公開募股（IPO）從 2026 年 10 月延後至 11 月，以便呈現強勁的第三季業績。投資人預期估值約為 2 兆美元，但不斷上升的基礎設施成本（僅與 SpaceX 合作案每月就高達 12.5 億美元）以及未解決的安全風險使上市變得複雜。這篇報導「繼 OpenAI 之後，據傳 Anthropic 也將延後首次公開募股（IPO）」首先發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.summary: Release: datasette-auth-github 1.0 I run this GitHub login plugin on the agent.datasette.io demo site and I noticed that my authenticated sessions weren't lasting very long. It turned out that the plugin was setting cookies without a Max-Age parameter, so they were expiring at the end of a browser session (which in Mobile Safari seems to happen pretty often, independently of how you are using the app.) I fixed that in #80 and, since this plugin has been around for quite a while and is tested against both Datasette 0.65.x and Datasette 1.0ax, I decided to bump it up to a 1.0 release. I'm trying to get better at promoting stable plugins to 1.0. Tags: github , plugins , datasette
